entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look, a treasure chest! Let's take whatever[n]is in there too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's okay. Hey, Joker, do you think[n]we can ambush it from here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It ought to go the same as when you hide[n]and jump on an enemy. Give it a shot.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I didn't realize even Shadows beg[n]for their lives... That's actually kind[n]of surprising...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shadows have emotions too, you know.[n]Of course they'll be afraid if you corner[n]them like that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It might be worth purposely creating such[n]situations to get them begging for their lives.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Shadows seem to have different[n]attitudes, too. If we take advantage of that,[n]negotiations may go more smoothly.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll try to let you know what kind of answers[n]the Shadows want to hear, depending[n]on their personalities.
